note: THE PINNED TEXTS of the canon layers (run 2026-11-11-full-canons), an input of tools/build_canon_layers.py. Each edition's verse-per-line text is the member of eBible.org's zip named here, and the build refuses it unless its sha256 is this one. The zip is never pinned: every member carries its build time. Pinned 2026-11-11 by builder-31 from the zips checker-99 measured at the run's ledger line 3 (eng-web ae3b6aca..944c, engDRA 7e267290..a7f0); eBible rebuilt eng-web's text on 2026-11-09, so a later rebuild fails the build closed and a new pin is a new step. Each source and its licence reason stand in the strict PD-only gate's table, tools/migrate_bible.py PD_VERIFIED_SOURCES.

eng-web.license: Public domain: its translators dedicated the World English Bible to the public domain (eBible.org: 'The World English Bible is in the Public Domain'). A changed text may not be called the World English Bible, so every verse is kept whole and verbatim.

engDRA.license: Public domain by its date: the Douay-Rheims American Edition of 1899, the printing of Challoner's 1749-52 revision (eBible.org: 'Public Domain').
